question: What is the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)** is a scheme launched by the **Government of India** to provide loans up to** Rs. 10 Lakh** to the **non-corporate, non-farm small/micro-enterprises.**
 
• These loans are categorized as **MUDRA loans** under **PMMY.**
 
• The aim of the scheme is to **promote entrepreneurship among new and existing enterprises.**
